overview: This table lists each background song, its in-game title and length, where the game uses it, and whether players start with it.
description: Catalog of background music tracks: their CRI cue-sheet/row names, gallery labels, track length, and whether the music is unlocked from the start.

Id.simple: The name the game uses to find this song in menus, story chapters, missions, and battles. Keep the names used by those modes matching if you change it.
Id.technical: FName primary key/exported as ID (DataTable ImportKeyField=Id; all 28 exported row names equal Id). Game phases look it up from request/story-chapter/mission-wave IDs; MainMenuTheme.Id_Bgm also names a BGM directly. The gallery uses it to test the user's heard-BGM set and to start playback; free-battle BgmId, when set, is passed straight to PlayBgm. DTM_CollectBattleBgmRows filters rows by a case-insensitive 'BATTLE' substring of Id and returns these rows to random battle selection, which picks one Id (default BGM_BATTLE_01). The sequencer's PlayBgm resolves a row then forwards Row->Id to SoundManager.PlayBgm, which uses it as the BGM loader/cue-sheet name. Export spells it ID.

CueSheetName.simple: The name of the sound set the game plays for this track. It is used for battle music and for the level sequence testing screen.
CueSheetName.technical: FString, default empty (inline constructor). Battle and level-sequencer/debug paths construct an FName from this string and pass it to PlayBgm; an empty string becomes an empty FName. BattleBase/MissionBase return it as the battle BGM name, falling back to an empty name (or literal BGM_BATTLE_01 when no row exists; MissionBase first retries the request BGM). All 28 exported rows repeat their row ID, but the field is independent: the gallery, sequencer, MainMenuTheme.Id_Bgm, free-battle choices and credit paths pass an Id/name directly without reading it.

Id_SoundText.simple: The song title shown in the sound collection after you unlock it. It also appears as a choice in free battle music options.
Id_SoundText.technical: FName. UGameCollectionSoundListItem::GetTitleTextId returns this row value; the collection item widget displays it for unlocked entries with SetTextIdOnly and a locked placeholder for unheard music. Non-SYS text IDs are resolved through the language-specific SoundText tables (SoundTextDataTable_<lang>) by GameTextManager: all 28 exported BGM IDs resolve in each of the 11 exported locale shards, and in the export this ID equals the row Id. It is also added as an option string in free-battle BGM option boxes, where an extra Random option is appended and SetUseTextId is enabled; selection uses Settings.BgmId.ToString() (the row Id), not this text ID.

Duration.simple: How long the song lasts, in seconds. The collection slider uses it for song length and progress, and full and short credits use it for scrolling time.
Duration.technical: float, default 0.0f. The credit scroll uses the BGM_DEMO_07 row minus 3.5 s and the BGM_DEMO_01 row directly as ease durations (types 2 and 3 use hardcoded 10/15 s instead). The collection slider sets its maximum to Duration, substituting 1.0f when abs(Duration) <= UE_SMALL_NUMBER; that guarded value also drives the mm:ss text, progress percentage, playback wrapping and the 0.1 s end-of-track check. Exported values are whole-number seconds (30-319 here), but the field itself is a float.

bInitialReleaseEnabled.simple: Whether the song is available in the sound collection from the start. Turn it on to make a track appear there before you hear it in play.
bInitialReleaseEnabled.technical: bool, default false. Startup (GamePhase_Startup state 0xC after the DLC query; also DebugBoot state 1) calls GM_ReapplyDlcUnlocks_131DC00: every row with this flag true is inserted with FindOrAdd into GameManager.UserInfo.StudioBgmNames_BE8 (new FStudioBgmState has bNew=true), alongside DLC item grants. That map is also populated when AGameSoundManager::PlayBgm broadcasts OnBgmChanged (bound in Boot) and is serialized in the save; the collection widget's unlock state is membership in that map and its NEW marker comes from the saved state. In the exported table only BGM_DEMO_10 is true, so the others start locked unless encountered in play or started by a hardcoded caller.

notes: Loaded as a 'DataTable' primary asset named BgmDataTable into DTM.BgmDataTables (+0x720) after all primary assets finish loading; GetRows returns rows in table order then row-name order. Status_FindBgmRow walks the table array in order and returns the first typed row; with bCheckNone=true it rejects NAME_None (battle/story callers pass true, the credit helper passes false), and the reconstructed body ignores bUnknown.

Playback arguments differ by caller and CueSheetName is not interchangeable with Id: BattleBase/MissionBase and the level-sequencer/debug widget look up a row and convert CueSheetName to FName; sequencer sound module and sound-collection list resolve a row and pass Row->Id; MainMenuTheme.Id_Bgm, free-battle chosen BgmId and the credit IDs go straight to PlayBgm without a BgmDataTables lookup. All reach AGameSoundManager::PlayBgm, which skips playback when BGM is disabled or the name is already current, then fades/loads the supplied name as a Sound primary asset/cue sheet. All 28 exported rows happen to have CueSheetName == Id, so the data does not expose the distinction.

DTM_CollectBattleBgmRows selects rows whose Id contains BATTLE case-insensitively (FString::Find from the start of the string, not a prefix test; 11 of 28 exported rows qualify). PickRandomBgm then uses random stream 0's RandHelper to pick one row's Id, or returns literal BGM_BATTLE_01 when no row qualifies; free battle uses a chosen BgmId before this fallback. This is a naming convention, not a dedicated flag.
The credit widget reads BGM_DEMO_07 (full credits) and BGM_DEMO_01 (short credits) without a null check, so a missing row would crash; no defensive fallback was observed there.

Source is reconstructed retail code with RVAs as provenance; exported assets are partial. Only one BgmDataTable export with 28 rows is available (no numbered BGM shards), so retail row completeness and all Blueprint-only references cannot be asserted.

Cross-checks against the read-only exports: every exported row key equals its ID field; all 28 CueSheetName and Id_SoundText values equal the row ID; the 28 Id_SoundText values exist in all 11 SoundText locale shards; 11 distinct MissionWave, 2 StoryChapter and 3 MainMenuTheme Id_Bgm references all resolve; only BGM_DEMO_10 has bInitialReleaseEnabled=true.

usages.detail: Requests BgmDataTable as a primary asset.
Collects rows whose Id contains BATTLE for random battle BGM selection.
Looks up the requested battle BGM and returns CueSheetName.
Falls back from wave BGM to request BGM and returns CueSheetName.
Sequencer PlayBgm resolves the row and plays using Row.Id.
Builds the sound-collection list from all Bgm rows.
Grants initially enabled BGMs at startup.
Uses Duration of fixed BGM IDs to drive the credit scroll.
PreparePhase plays the GetBattleBgmName result (row CueSheetName or fallback) through SoundManager.PlayBgm.
PickRandomBgm collects battle rows and selects one Id from random stream 0; missing rows fall back to BGM_BATTLE_01.
Populates free-battle BGM options from battle rows' Id_SoundText and appends Random.
Collection playback passes row Id plus stored PlaybackPosition to SoundManager.PlayBgm.
Resolves StoryChapter.Id_Bgm to a Bgm row and caches it in BgmResumes keyed by Bgm->Id.
Plays MainMenuTheme.Id_Bgm directly; no BgmDataTables row lookup.
Debug BGM selector plays the first row's CueSheetName by selected Id.
OnBgmChanged records the played BGM name in the heard set.
Loads localized SoundText tables used to resolve Id_SoundText.
